materiality: SafeUnpickler previously admitted broad standard-library and multiprocessing module globals; upstream now uses exact-name allowlists and rejects unlisted globals by default.

The upstream regression explicitly rejects copyreg._reconstructor while preserving supported Python objects and tensor round trips, making this an execution-boundary hardening candidate rather than cosmetic churn.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports CPU deserialization regression tests passing.
Upstream did not run model-server or distributed tensor-transfer tests; source support is not a whole-runtime security receipt.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source, wheel/container and Python/runtime identities.
Inventory every SZL path that can deserialize untrusted, persisted or cross-process payloads and prove it reaches the constrained loader where intended.
Add positive round trips for admitted payload classes and negative fixtures for rejected standard-library, multiprocessing and gadget-like globals, malformed/truncated bytes and nested containers.
Prove no fallback path silently calls unrestricted pickle and run distributed-transfer/model-server regression where executable.
Keep unexercised paths UNQUALIFIED and preserve rollback to the incumbent exact runtime.

materiality: The FlashInfer TRT-LLM MoE backend silently ignored swiglu_limit for model families that route their trained clamp semantics through that field.
Upstream GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 evidence reports GSM8K strict-match mean 0.9277 before versus 0.9360 after, matching the upstream Triton baseline mean 0.9360.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: The upstream numbers are not SZL measurements and do not qualify other models, precisions, kernels or hardware.
The source change is scoped to FlashInfer TRT-LLM activation-parameter preparation and must be independently reached and measured.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang, FlashInfer/TRT-LLM, model, checkpoint, tokenizer, device and quantization identities.
Add activation-level fixtures proving the clamped SwiGLU formula and an executable known-bad predecessor control.
Compare fixed-seed logits/outputs against an independently correct backend for every admitted model/configuration that uses swiglu_limit; separately prove explicit gemm1_clamp_limit retains priority.
Measure performance only after correctness closes and preserve rollback.

materiality: Multiple Mooncake clients sharing one SSD offload directory can generate colliding bucket ids and O_CREAT|O_TRUNC can silently replace another rank's cache bytes.
The repair gives DP/TP/PP/attention-CP ranks private offload directories, converting a silent data-integrity hazard into isolated cache state.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream base and extra CI were reported green while an AMD lane was not green; those checks are not an SZL multi-rank storage receipt.
Existing root-level cached buckets become orphaned and should be treated as recomputable cache loss, never migrated as trusted state without proof.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang/Mooncake build, topology and storage configuration.
Construct deterministic same-second/restart multi-rank collision controls against a known-bad predecessor and prove unique DP/TP/PP/attention-CP paths after repair.
Verify byte-for-byte cache retrieval through concurrency, restart, cancellation and eviction; stale root data must miss/recompute instead of being reused across ranks.
Preserve rollback and never infer cache correctness from successful process startup alone.

materiality: A supplemental 32-token FlashInfer BF16 warmup could leak its bounded tuning buckets into unrelated operations, allowing an MXFP8 drafter GEMM to reuse a low-M tactic outside its supported input.
Upstream B200 probes report correct MXFP8 bucket retention and cosine similarity 0.99930 after isolation, but full pytest and end-to-end model serving were not completed.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM, FlashInfer, CuTe/CUDA, device and model/runtime identities.
Add a deterministic cross-operation tuning-context fixture and known-bad predecessor control proving non-BF16 operations cannot inherit supplemental BF16 buckets.
Exercise cache persistence/reload and representative MXFP8 shapes against an independent numerical reference before any throughput claim.
Keep unexecuted device lanes UNAVAILABLE and preserve rollback.

materiality: Released MiniMax-M2 checkpoints use legacy rotary_dim=64 with head_dim=128 for partial RoPE, while the in-tree config previously left rotary_dim opaque and silently rotated the full head dimension.
Upstream reports mean KL 13.1 and cosine 0.02 versus a faithful reference over 2,048 tokens before the repair, a substantial semantic divergence.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact Transformers wheel/source and exact checkpoint/config/tokenizer bytes.
Test legacy rotary_dim mapping, explicit partial_rotary_factor precedence and configs without the legacy field against an independent frequency/rotate-half reference.
Run an executable known-bad predecessor control and fixed-seed logits/output parity, including remote-code versus in-tree parity when legally and operationally available.
No generic Transformers qualification transfers; preserve rollback.

materiality: Wrapped sequence packing could size output from a sliced Arrow view but read token data from the underlying unsliced child buffer, silently repeating early dataset rows in later Dataset.map batches.
Row and token counts remain plausible, so training receipts based only on cardinality can miss the corruption.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports 10 targeted packing tests plus randomized reference comparisons and multi-process end-to-end checks.
Those tests do not establish whether any SZL training receipt used the affected wrapped-packing toolchain.
requiredEvidence: Inventory every admitted SZL training/post-training recipe that used TRL wrapped packing and bind TRL, Datasets and PyArrow versions plus recipe/data revisions.
Add deterministic multi-batch content-hash and row-order fixtures covering sliced offsets, ragged/empty rows, multiple columns, list/large-list and multi-process map.
Require a known-bad predecessor to reproduce duplication and mark any affected historical training receipt NEEDS_REVALIDATION until rebuilt or replayed from exact input bytes.
Do not retroactively declare PASS from unchanged row/token counts.
